description: List every API key stored in the local ProphetKey vault, returning each key's name, provider, safe_key identifier, and health status. Call this first to discover which safe_key to pass to prophetkey_make_request. Reads local vault metadata only: it never returns real key values and never contacts a provider. To inspect one key in detail, use prophetkey_get_key_info instead.

provider.description: Optional provider filter, matched case-insensitively (e.g. 'openai', 'anthropic', 'cursor'). Omit to list keys from every provider.

name: prophetkey_list_keys
title: List API keys
